description:
Problem: the published docs are built from the newest core develop bundle, so they describe unreleased code and the landing page reported v0.5.1 as the current release before it existed. Outcome: the repository carries a release pin, the docs inputs of one published core release, that the docs build can read instead of the develop bundle.

Build `scripts/docs-pin.mjs` (`npm run docs:pin`) and commit `release-pin/` for v0.5.0.

Pin layout (mirrors the bundle so existing digest code applies): `release-pin/pin.json` `{tag, core_sha}`, `release-pin/manifest.json` (the release bundle's manifest, byte-identical), `release-pin/docs-data/docs-data.json`, `release-pin/doc-contracts.json`, `release-pin/repo-files.json`.

`docs:pin -- vX.Y.Z`: (1) GitHub release for the tag in CORE_REPO must exist, not draft, not prerelease; (2) resolve the tag to its commit; (3) fetch that commit's bundle with the existing bundle-fetch path (`SITE_INPUTS_CORE_SHA`, temp `SITE_INPUTS`), which runs full verification; (4) require manifest.core_sha == tag commit and manifest.package_version == tag without the leading v; (5) check the three members against manifest.members with `memberDigest`; (6) replace `release-pin/` atomically. `--from <bundle dir>` skips step 3 only, for a bundle verified elsewhere.

`docs:pin -- --check`: offline part re-checks pin.json/manifest agreement and the three member digests; online part (skipped with `--offline`) re-checks the release is published and the tag commit equals pin.json core_sha.

`docs:pin -- --pending`: exits non-zero and prints both tags when core's latest published release is newer than the pin; used by the nightly reminder.

Constraints: Node only, no Python. No explanatory comments (lint:comments). Reuse `githubJson`, `CORE_REPO`, `memberDigest`, `siteInputsDir`; add no second digest format. v0.5.0 is a one-off: its doc-contracts.json lacks `path_privacy`, which the current schema requires, so fetch and fully verify it with a checkout of this repository at the parent of a0c4525, then run `docs:pin -- v0.5.0 --from <dir>`. Do not loosen the bundle schema or verifier.
